changelogs.title: v2.5.0: Console Manager & Multi-Platform Update
items: PlayStation 5 Console Manager: Remote game explorer and library manager over LAN, exploring Internal Storage (/data/homebrew, /data/etahen/games), USB drives, and M.2 SSD (/mnt/ext*).
Embedded PS5 Machete Daemon (v1.5.4): Native C daemon with atomic size caching, sub-second folder scans, deep directory recursion for massive 300,000+ file titles, and POSIX signal safety.
Desktop Keyboard Orchestrator: Added native cross-platform shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+F search focus, Cmd/Ctrl+A select all, Cmd/Ctrl+R refresh, Escape navigation).
Multi-Platform Hardening: Safe root drive protection for Windows and POSIX systems, trailing path normalization, and audio device leak elimination.
Audio Engine Upgrade: PCM WAV fallback support for homebrew PS5 containers, Deezer API soundtrack preview integration, and Web Audio graph lifecycle disposal.
NVMe Saturation Pipeline: Multi-threaded Blake3 hashing with Rayon for maximal transfer throughput.
React Rendering Optimizations: Component memoization and bounded metadata streaming for smooth performance across massive game collections.

changelogs.title: v2.4.0: Quality Assurance Update
items: Fixed severe race condition in GameDetailsModal where unmounting during background audio load created zombie audio processes.
Eradicated React state memory leaks caused by lingering async folder size calculations.
Resolved multiple CSS flexbox overflow bugs that broke the UI layout with long German/Russian titles.
Purged obsolete legacy JSON translation keys to optimize load times.

changelogs.title: v2.3.10: Surgical Audio Extraction
items: Engineered a highly precise mathematical parser for the Sony PKG Table of Contents (ToC) to extract snd0.at9 with zero guessing.
Fixed 'Nada Suena' bug where large PCM WAV cutscene files near the beginning of PS5 containers confused the ATRAC9 decoder.
Implemented strict case-insensitive file extension filtering to prevent text/xml files from crashing the audio player.

changelogs.version: v2.3.7 - Ultimate Audio Engine & Memory Leak Eradication
items: Eradicated 31 GB RAM leak caused by parallel Tauri IPC Base64 serialization of 200MB payloads.
Eradicated infinite CPU hang and 25 GB thread-stacking memory leak by replacing the O(N * M) 0xFE heuristic scanner.
Implemented hyper-fast 16MB RIFF mathematical chunk extraction for all containers (PKG, ISO, FFPKG).
Added 50KB largest-chunk prioritization to perfectly isolate the 8MB snd0.at9 game theme and ignore 5KB UI click sound loops.
Unlocked 8192-byte padding tolerance in decode_at9_to_wav to chew through proprietary Sony padding seamlessly.

changelogs.version: v2.3.0 - Major Multiplatform, ATRAC9 Audio Engine & Diagnostic Update
items: Pure Rust Sony ATRAC9 native audio decoder and Web Audio API background streaming player for official soundtracks (snd0.at9).
Exact decimal SDK version detection (SDK 9.00, SDK 8.50, SDK 7.61) and Title App version (v1.00, v1.02) with zero raw hex strings.
Complete Windows hardening: explorer.exe argument fix, automatic read-only attribute stripping, and accurate drive space detection.
Complete Linux hardening: POSIX statvfs calls for Steam Deck / UDisks2, D-Bus ShowItems file manager selection, and case-insensitivity.
macOS innovations: live Dock progress badge (NSDockTile) during background transfers and instant APFS Copy-on-Write cloning.
Multi-language NSIS Windows installer (10 languages) in currentUser mode and build cache acceleration.

changelogs.version: v2.2.0 - Pure ATRAC9 Audio Engine & Diagnostic Update
items: Integrated pure Rust ATRAC9 native audio decoder for PlayStation 5 and PS4 snd0.at9 soundtracks.
Automatic game soundtrack preview playback in Game Details modal with interactive BGM controls and volume fade.
Exact compilation SDK detection (SDK 9.00, SDK 8.50, SDK 7.61, etc.) and minimum system software requirements.
Real game application version extraction (appVer) with 4MB container header inspection probe.
Optimized core stability, unified release milestones, and updated technical documentation.

changelogs.version: v2.1.2 - Audio Engine Hotfix & Synthesis Optimization
items: Resolved WebKit AudioContext zero-value exponential curve exception.
Switched to universal safe linear ramps for crystal-clear, high-volume PS5 UI sound effects.
Immediate synchronous audio context reactivation on game card hover and selection.

changelogs.version: v2.1.1 - UI Refinement, Audio & macOS Menu
items: Fixed box art double-header superposition defect for full-bleed 4K master covers.
Unlocked WebKit/Safari AudioContext with enhanced PS5 acoustic synthesis on card hover and select.
Added dynamic multi-language dropdown in Settings with English (en) set as the default.
Streamlined top bar layout and integrated native macOS application menu items (About, Check for Updates, Settings Cmd+,).

changelogs.version: v2.1.0 - Next-Gen Update & CDN Edge Sovereign
items: Proprietary Low-Latency Global Edge CDN: High-speed Cloudflare R2 Edge server hosting over 11,940 vertical 4K master covers (3:4 aspect ratio) with official white PS5 headers, resolving covers globally in <15ms without third-party dependencies.

Uncompromising Privacy & Absolute Anonymity: Zero telemetry, zero tracking, zero IP logging, and zero analytics. Generic browser User-Agent requests with zero fingerprinting. Your storage and backups remain 100% private and local.

Native & Exhaustive ShadowMountPlus Support: Comprehensive streaming inspection (1MB header probe) for all formats in the ShadowMountPlus ecosystem (.ffpkg UFS, .exfat 64KB, .ffpfs PFS, .ffpfsc MicroMount/MkPFS containers) and folder dumps.
3D Anti-Gravity Visual Engine: Floating inertial levitation, real-time 3D tilt with 1200px perspective, and cursor-reactive floor shadows.
Native PS5 Acoustic Synthesis & ATRAC9 Decoding: Original sinusoidal harmonic selection chime and native Rust snd0.at9 audio decoder to listen to official game soundtracks.
Interactive Storage Analyzer & Batch Mode: Treemap disk visualizer with heatmap rankings and floating batch action bar with keyboard shortcuts.
System Settings Panel: Full control to toggle 3D visual effects and acoustic audio with persistent local storage.
Rust 2021 Engine with opt-level=3 and LazyLock: High-throughput NVMe I/O transfers with instant macOS APFS Copy-On-Write clonefile acceleration.
Integrated Tauri v2 auto-updater with Minisign cryptographic verification.
Seamless in-app download and installation from GitHub Releases with live progress bar.
Real-time update notifications without restarting.
New Cyberpunk interface (3D Cards, Hacker Console, Holographic Disk).
Asynchronous Tokio-powered I/O engine.
Dynamic directory size calculation.
Fixed 0 GB size calculation bug on directory backups.
Added total GB indicator to top bar.
Custom title and cover art override support.
Optimized default window dimensions.
SSD scan warning on high-capacity drives.
Official release of Machete PS5 Backup Manager.
Automated high-resolution cover downloading.
PPSA badge placement in bottom corner.
Strict API request anonymization.
